cards.card_text: Their reason: "His hand is heavy upon us and upon our god Dagon." Friend, if I walked into my bakery two mornings in a row and found my oven face-down on the floor, I would NOT be waiting around for morning number three.
cards.verse_text: And when the men of Ashdod saw what was happening, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel must not stay here with us, because His hand is heavy upon us and upon our god Dagon.”
